question: What can a participant do after accepting the item assignment?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour Participant After Accepting Assignment
youtubeLink.description: This video explains what a participant can do after accepting the item assignment

sections.beforeHtml: After acceptance, the shared item becomes part of the participant`s personal trip work. Plantour creates a corresponding row in that participant`s Trip Items list.
items: Find the accepted item in your personal trip items. Plantour shows assignment status text there so you can see that it came from a shared-item assignment.
If you need to organize it physically, assign the item to a trip bag and move it through the normal trip-item packing workflow.
When you complete the assignment successfully, mark Finished success on that trip item row.
If you attempted it but it failed, mark Finished failure on that trip item row.
Plantour sends the admin a notification when you finish the accepted item successfully or with failure.
sections.afterHtml: The shared-item page is where assignment is accepted or rejected. The personal Trip Items page is where the accepted work is actually packed and finished.
